scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.join('..','client','public');const dst=path.join('public');if(!fs.existsSync(src)){console.log('no client src');process.exit(0)};fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});console.log('client copied to',dst)"
